channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jordan Hill | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jordan Hill from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Byron Scott on Jordan Hill
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Byron Scott:

“We messed with J.Hill and told him Mitch wanted to see him.”

Byron Scott on Jordan Hill, Feb 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Jordan Hill
item.description:
“Jordan has been a consistent contributor for us over the last three seasons and we are pleased to keep him in the Laker family,”

Mitch Kupchak on Jordan Hill, Jul 23, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Nick Young on Jordan Hill
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Nick Young on the locker room atmosphere after the win:

“I seen people jumping around w/ no clothes on. Not naming names, but Jordan Hill”

Nick Young on Jordan Hill, Mar 24, 2014. Source: Twitter @mcten.
